scope: Remaining-function batch; no new full 39-file parsing or all-paper scientific accuracy score

scientific_review.method: Inspect complete original rendered pages and explicitly cited excerpts; keep machine scores separate from scientific quality.

review_first.boundary: 20 originals in evidence pool, 10 actually cited; not 20 papers each individually summarized or a statistical stability result.

checks: ViT performance claim retains large-data pretraining and transfer conditions.
CLIP objective matches original page 4 across its two columns; native concatenation mismatch is not absent text.
CLIP efficiency comparison retains both ResNet comparator and 12-dataset suite.
ViT size comparison retains all three pretraining sets and ImageNet fine-tuning evaluation.
LoRA ratios retain GPT-3 175B / Adam comparator; no new experiment is fabricated.
Deferred 4x CLIP objective comparison is supported on original page 4, not counted as another framework paragraph.
English-to-Chinese public abstract retains EN-DE versus EN-FR scores, ensemble versus single-model scope, days and GPU count.
Chinese-to-English public method summary retains architecture and published-method versus new-project-results distinction.
Synthetic short paper retains proposed-not-conducted status, test-only values, formula, code, URL, citation and glossary.

comparison.reason: The last extra inference/assessment claim attributes both 0.7 and 0.25 to dialogue. Original page 25 labels 0.7 as Anthropic-HH dialogue; page 24 labels 0.25 as TL;DR summaries. Core scope is correct; this extra claim is not. Do not combine rounds into a full 4/4 pass.
comparison.malformed_json_first_positive: Preserved as generation-format failure and explicit extractive fallback, not retrieval failure.

issues.reason: Unsubstantiated paper-wide assertion that a combination was not validated; the QLoRA excerpt explicitly describes use of LoRA with quantization.
Warm-up necessity loses the large-learning-rate condition; reverse source word order bypassed the old narrow guard.
Restricts FlashAttention to IO-complexity analysis despite the cited abstract also describing an algorithm and experiments; extra exclusivity remains for source review.

review_source_fixed.guard_fix_scope: First two forms now have offline positive/negative regression protection; no paid generation after that final patch.

future_work.partial_progress_case: Transformer multimodal/local-attention plan versus ViT image classification; human needs_review retained, not declared fully resolved.
future_work.scanned_limit: Core text readable in rendered pages; OCR noise remains, including n transcribed as 7 on page 6. Exact mathematical transcription is not certified.

scientific_review.full_page_images: source-pages-2 and pinned 2026-10-18 QLoRA/LoRA/InstructGPT/DPO renders; rendered from unchanged official PDFs.

future_workflow.scope: Eight fixed official-source controls and six actual review API checks; not solved-idea classification
